# SetupStep

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Setup` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Setup/SetupRunner.cs#L14)

One piece of work in a setup sequence, plus the question "is it finished yet?".
Most steps are done the moment [`Run`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-setup/SetupStep#run) returns. The ones that hand work to Unity -
switching platform, resolving a package, importing a sample - are not, so they also carry an
[`IsFinished`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-setup/SetupStep#isfinished) the runner polls until it answers true.

## Properties

### IsFinished {#isfinished}

Polled once per editor frame after [`Run`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-setup/SetupStep#run) until it answers true or the step
runs out of time. Write these to treat "the thing I was watching is gone" as finished: a
domain reload wipes the request objects they watch, and Unity only reloads once the work
that triggered it is done anyway.

